merges.into: compare_across_conditions; track_feature_across_series kept only for identified objects through frame sequences
merges.why: Judge candidate C1 (usage compare_across_conditions [98,26], track [17,9]). In my 4 papers the spectral stacks (absorbance vs QD wt%, AdvMat 201404945#a23; post-immersion XRD across alloys, bioactmat.2021.03.045#z22) were read with compare_across_conditions / assign_features with no loss, because the OBS type (feature_quantification, feature_presence) already says what changes. The one edge that needed track_ was an object-identity reading: which layer is locked in each compression photograph (AdvMat 201706311#o22->o23/o24); identity of the layer across frames is what licenses the locking-order MEC (o24). That use keeps its information under the restricted definition.

Judge candidate Q2 (extract_slope [7,6], fit_model [4,3]). I could not tell them apart on AdvMat 201706311#o13->o14: the pre/post-locking stiffnesses are slopes of straight segments reported with R2, i.e. both 'slope of a line' and 'one-parameter fit'. I chose fit_model; another annotator would reasonably choose extract_slope, so the pair splits identical acts across two labels. The diagnostic chain (slope -> PRP/diagnostic -> KNW/lookup) stays visible through the dst type, not the op. Nothing is lost if attrs.form records the linearised form.

Judge candidate P1 (partition [2,2]). Never needed in 4 papers. The one partition-like reading I met (origami stiffness from crease bending before locking, from facet bending/twisting after; FE stress render F2e, AdvMat 201706311#o17->o18) is carried entirely by MEC/pathway + compare_across_conditions; a PRP/partition node would have duplicated the MEC. Support merge together with O2.

merges.into: OBS/response/trend (the op compare_coplotted_quantities carries the dominance reading)
merges.why: Judge candidate O2 (component_partition [3,3]). Never needed; coplotted quantities in my papers (absorbance vs ON/OFF, FE vs experiment curves) were typed trend/characteristic_value with the op naming the comparison. No r04 node of mine would lose information.

merges.into: prune: flag_outlier -> cross_check_consistency; subtract_reference -> replot_derived_series; collapse_by_normalization -> overlay_model_on_data or cross_check_consistency
merges.why: Judge candidate K1. None used on 189 edges in my 4 r04 papers (and only 1-2 uses in r01-r03). quantify_from_position also had zero uses here.

splits.proposal: Do NOT merge regime_map into trend wholesale (judge O1). Split by reading: contour maps of a single response over two design variables go to OBS/response/trend with attrs.dimension=2D; regime_map is kept for boundaries between states and for coexistence/stability windows, including 1-D ones (bistable frequency band, hysteresis window).
splits.why: Two r04 nodes in one paper test O1 from both sides. AdvMat 201706311#o6 (F1d,e: deformability and relative-volume contours over sector angles) is a trend in 2D; typing it trend lost nothing. But #o31 (F4c: high- and low-amplitude response branches coexist between ~12 and 25 Hz) is read for which state(s) exist at a given condition; the next node is a bistability PRF claim, which a trend (direction/monotonicity) does not license. The definition should say '1-D windows included' so this does not look like a poor fit.

indistinguishable_in_practice.note: Bar charts or curves of categorical groups (coated/uncoated, alloy A/B/C) are readable either as 'value at a condition' or as 'ranking'. I used trend when the ranking is the claim (s18, z18) and characteristic_value when named levels are read (s16, z17), but the choice is arbitrary for biomedical group comparisons, which dominate these journals. Proposed boundary text for trend: 'categorical groups ranked against each other = trend (attrs.aspect=ranking); named levels such as Ecorr or onset = characteristic_value.' No merge: the two leaves diverge clearly on continuous variables.

Coating 'phases' (brushite, MgF2, strontium phosphate) named only from EDS stoichiometry (Ca:P ~1:1) vs degradation products identified by XRD (ZnO, CaCO3). Proposed boundary text: a phase named without diffraction/spectroscopic structural evidence is STR/chemistry/composition with attrs.phase_named_from = stoichiometry; phase/identity requires structure-sensitive evidence. This matters because the audit s14 (inner 'MgF2' layer is Ca/P-dominated) only arises when the phase claim is seen to rest on composition.

comments: Confirmation round: 154 nodes / 189 edges over 4 papers (device photonics, architected metamaterial, two in-vivo biodegradable-metal papers). Every node is typed with a v03 entry, none poor and none proposed, so I make no type or op proposals. Boundary text did the work, as the judge predicted: in-vivo degradation -> PRP chemical_corrosion (s28, z39); bone endpoints -> PRF/service_capability (s32, z36); host-free cell data -> PRP biological; direct-write NW arches and laser drilling -> PRC/forming (a8, z8); hot extrusion of cast billets -> PRC/treatment (s6, z7); screen-then-choose -> DES/down_select via motivates (z16). Two small boundary gaps for the judge: (1) chemical conversion coatings (Sr-P, fluoride + Ca-P on Mg; s7, s8) react with the substrate rather than 'apply material'; I typed PRC/deposition with attrs.aspect=conversion and suggest one sentence in its definition. (2) Metamaterial prototypes: 'self-locking' is a kinematic behaviour of the built cell, and PRP/behavior_class with attrs.object carried it (o7). Figure-reading notes: (a) Bioactive 2021.03.045 packet is missing paper Fig. 5 (micro-CT); packet F5-F7 are paper Figs 6-8. (b) In Bioactive 2020.11.026 F3a the Sr-P OCP drifts ~75 mV toward active in the first 400 s, whereas the text says both coatings drift noble (s15 marked partial); F3a's axis says mV but values are in V. (c) The MatMech record for 2020.11.026 gives Ca-P in-vivo CR 0.032 mm/y; F7B shows ~0.35 mm/y. (d) AdvMat 201706311 F4c (dynamic bistability) is computed only, although the MatMech record calls it an experiment. Budget note: I opened 4 figures per paper (16 total). Figures I did not open appear as OBS with figs=[] and attrs.fig_ref, so no image_support is claimed for them.
